This is terrible...\nI can't believe that there's no one we could save\neither here...!
W-what...Even a Sproutling has turned into a\nmonster too?!
Why?! I don't wanna fight anymore...Argh!!
Don't kill us!\nWe've got nothing with us, we're not armed!!
Relax, I won't hurt you because I'm also a Eumano.\nNow come out carefully...Yeah, slowly.
What's your name?
C-Cerrit...
And you?
She's Menti, my younger sister. Our parents were\nattacked and killed by a Coenubia right in front\nof her and she has gone mute ever since...
Her mouth is moving though, is she eating\nsomething?
Relaxia Leaf. Chewing it helps her relax.
Huh? Oh, Relaxia Leaf is a delicacy loved by the\nEumanos.
The juice that comes out when you chew it has a\ncalming effect...
We can't just leave them here. Can they come with\nus? I'll take full responsibility to protect them\nwhen enemies attack.
T-thank you!\nLet's go then!
